sources.title: HÖ12 field reports lane report
sources.notes: Field lane completed. Best overlapping report is Sydsverige.dk updated 2026-03-03, whose Etape 4 is broader than official HÖ12 because it continues to Sävsjö station; it says the route is clearly marked, notes water and possible toilet at Hultsjö church, hilly forest paths, wider gravel road near Hjärtlanda, and approach to Sävsjö along Eksjöhovgårdssjön. It also says no running water on the broader route and lake water should be boiled/filtered. Important currentness risk: Sävsjö municipality reported on 2026-04-07 that the Eksjöhovgårdssjön exercise loop was fully closed after Storm Dave due to fallen/leaning trees; this is not explicitly a Höglandsleden closure but affects endpoint/Bockudden confidence. Bockudden is an official 0.9 km side branch, built Dec 2024, with 50 cm boardwalk/forest path, shelter for six, adjacent grill and bathing/fishing possibility. Komoot supports Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin endpoint services but not trail condition. Older Sävsjö/Utsidan/AllTrails sources are stale or not HÖ12-specific.

sources.title: HÖ14 rules/safety/currentness lane report
sources.notes: Rules lane completed. HÖ14 passes through Vikskvarn nature reserve (NVR 2042346, decision 2014-05-15, latest effective 2015-02-26, about 72.32 ha by NVR WFS/73.3 ha by Länsstyrelsen) and Vikskvarn Natura 2000 SE0310403. Vikskvarn reserve rules prohibit damaging natural objects/dead wood, collecting mosses/lichens/polypores and several other activities; group camp activity over 30 participants needs Länsstyrelsen permission. MSB fire-ban API returned no formal fire ban for Forsa/Vikskvarn on 2026-04-29, but fire-risk API returned riskIndex 3 issued 2026-04-29T19:00:00 and valid into 2026-04-30 morning. Dynamic fire status must be rechecked. Forsa bathing is not listed in HaV Sävsjö bathing-water list, so do not imply water-quality sampling.

sources.title: HÖ19 official-source lane report
sources.notes: Official-source lane completed. Confirmed HÖ19 Tomtabacken-Hok, Naturkartan/Smålandsleden site 128411, slug ho19-tomtabacken-hok, 20.0 km, 5 h, Blå - medel, GPX start Tomtabacken 57.50100/14.46514 and GPX end Hok 57.53825/14.27461. Official description: starts at Tomtabacken, Småland/South Swedish Highlands/Götaland high point at 377 m with lookout tower, shelter, accessible dry toilet and parking; route passes lakes, deep forest and viewpoints; western entrance reaches Hooks herrgård with golf, hotel and spa; just before Hooks herrgård there is a turnoff to Hok village/train connection. Endpoint objects: Tomtabacken ledentré HÖ18/HÖ19 site 135058 at 57.50112358157716/14.46526765625953 and Hok/Hook herrgård Ledentré HÖ19/HÖ20 site 128323 near the GPX end, with cafe/restaurant, lodging, drinking water, entrance and parking. Official nearby/connectors include HÖ20, Anslutning Lyngemadens naturreservat 2.4 km, Falla mosse, Tomtabacken ledentré/rastplats/utsikt/torrtoalett, Alnaberget, Hok/Hook herrgård ledentré, Stoarp/offerkälla, Avstickare Stoarp, Avstickare Alnaberget, Anslutning Hok station-HÖ19/HÖ20, Kvarnsfallsleden-Hatten and Lyngemadssjön. Lyngemadssjön reserve rules include no damaging/removing trees/bushes/natural objects, no collecting mosses/lichens/fungi except edible fungi, no collecting invertebrates, fires only with brought wood, no parking motor vehicles/caravans/trailers in the reserve, no signs/posters and permits for large organized events/camps. sources.title: HÖ19 transit and access lane report
sources.notes: Transit/access lane completed. Tomtabacken start has no credible direct bus stop within about 8-10 km; treat as car/taxi/pickup access at signed parking/entrance. Tomtabacken parking/entrance coordinate was reported approximately 57.50032/14.47008, about 305 m from GPX start, but this exact parking coordinate should be cross-checked because HÖ18 research also has the official Tomtabacken ledentré at 57.5011236/14.4652677. Malmbäck station at 57.57779/14.45973 on JLT/Krösatågen line 1086 is about 8.5 km straight-line and is a distant transit fallback. Hok end is much stronger: JLT confirms Hok Hooks herrgård stop on line 141 near the GPX endpoint, but coordinates are inferred near the endpoint because JLT stop page did not expose coordinates. Hok station at about 57.51405/14.27519 has train/bus service on line 1086 plus bus lines 136/141 and station parking; it is about 2.7 km straight-line from the GPX end, but the official unmarked station connector from the main trail toward Hok station may be shorter than walking from Hooks Herrgård. Hooks Herrgård parking/pickup is practical but may be private/customer-facing. No ferry/boat applies. JLT line 1086 timetable validity checked as 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12; line 136/141 validity checked as 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14. JLT Närtrafik should not be modeled as normal visitor trail access.

sources.notes: Transit/access lane completed. At the Åsafors end, no fixed-route stop named Åsafors was found in Samtrafiken/Resrobot GTFS or OSM; official entrance text says there are some houses, no direct parking, but pickup/dropoff is possible. Nearest fixed-route stops found are Marieholm Skärvhult 57.390198/13.835885 about 8.97 km, Åsehöga Smedjebo 57.392557/13.819623 about 9.13 km and Marieholm Skarköpsvägen 57.384950/13.856440 about 9.16 km, all on sparse JLT line 254 Gnosjö-Marieholm-Hillerstorp, valid 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14 and mainly non-holiday weekdays with school/holiday annotations. No ferry/boat applies. JLT Närtrafik exists but is prebooked rural-address service and should not be imported as general hiker access. Nearby Skillingaryds skjutfält notices may change, but HÖ22 pages do not say the route crosses closed military area; avoid detours into marked/restricted shooting-field areas. Naturkartan transit widgets showed Inga hållplatser hittades despite JLT/GTFS and Smålandsleden evidence; do not rely on widget absence. GTFS Grönelund elsewhere in Sweden is unrelated; line 134 should not be used because JLT line page says no active stops.
